documents.title: Thermal drift calibration
documents.text: Temperature drift in a sensor changes its baseline. Compare calibrated and uncalibrated residual mean squared error on matched samples; a lower residual does not alone establish field reliability.

documents.title: Missing sensor observations
documents.text: Sensor dropout creates missing observations. Compare an imputation variant with the baseline on a held-out sequence and report the missingness rate and reconstruction error.
